description: Use this whenever the user asks about a specific open-weight model: how good it is, its benchmark scores, whether it's worth using, how much VRAM or memory it needs, or which quantization to download. Returns our test scores, rank, memory at each quantization, the smallest GPU and Mac it fits, decision accuracy and our Q4 run on a Mac when there is one. Accepts a name or slug, e.g. 'qwen3.5 9b' or 'gpt-oss-20b'.
name: get_model
title: Get one model's results
